title: The Rain and the Tunnel
can_do: 把一天里的两件事按顺序讲出来，并带上“在哪儿、和谁”的细节。

conversation_move.label: tell two events in order with details

trigger: Dad asks about the school day, and Child organizes two events with time and place details.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Tell me about your day at school!

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Two big things happened today, Daddy.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Two things! Start with the first one.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: At morning circle, we sang the weather song. I was the rain!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: You were the rain! What was second?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: At the sand table, I dug a deep tunnel with Sam.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: A rain singer and a tunnel digger!

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The tunnel had two rooms, like our house.

replay_cards.title: The school garden
replay_cards.change: Dad asks about the new school garden.
replay_cards.challenge: Child tells two things — planting seeds and finding a worm — in order, with details about where and who helped.

replay_cards.title: Grandma's weekend question
replay_cards.challenge: Child tells two events from the weekend in order and answers her follow-up question about his favorite part.

parent_support: 问“今天学校怎么样”后忍住别追问太快，让孩子自己组织两件事。
孩子讲完一件时用“然后呢”推进，不替他总结。
夸细节而不是夸流利：“你说清了在哪儿、和谁一起。”
